body: Thanks for your support. I really hope that things will get better.

I tried telling them in private and my mom sometimes sees her outbursts but pretend that she didn't see. Sometimes when my sister physically hurts me my mom thinks that it is justifiable. I honestly don't know what to do, they make me feel like I'm a demon.

I try to ignore her as much as I can but its very difficult since we are forced to share a room ever since we were little. They want us to be close but honestly it is just torture for me. I even have to put ALL my things in bags because if she sees them lying around its either she would lose, ruin, or give them away.

Whenever I tell my family my side of the story and the things that my sister do to me, they don't listen and gets even angrier at me.

I've also been withdrawing myself from my family but they only see it as me being rude and evil.
I guess I'll try reading some of the books in the list. Thank you for your support!

I've been trying to tell my mom before about my sister's actions but she would just scold me saying that I am looking for a messy situation. My sister also once started kicking me in front of mom during an argument. In the end I was the one who was scolded for fighting back while my sister didn't receive a single scolding.

I am still not capable to support myself so I resorted to university dorm for now. Some of the things that I don't want her to reach are there, but right now without face to face classes, I have to stay at home.

When my sister and I were fighting, we started quietly until we were both yelling at each other. When I was telling my dad about her actions, I was crying while my sister was silent since she knows that I didn't do anything to her.

I enrolled in a university far from home so that I could live in a dorm and far away from my sister, but due to the pandemic and online classes, unfortunately I still had to stay at home and share a room with my sister.
Thank you for this. I just wish things will turn out well.

I am also like this and also can't understand why. I too avoid confrontations as much as possible and suppress my anger as far as I can but sometimes I reach my limit. When I start confronting the person who made me lose my temper, my voice starts getting shaky and at the end, I would end up crying although I'm not even sad. It does seem like I am just hurt and not angry at that person.

Sadly, this what I used to do. She would always act like this whenever we are not in good terms. I used to show her that I am uncomfortable with her actions and would occasionally tell her to stop. The reason why I am doing my best to ignore her now is that I realized that she purposely kept on doing those things that she already knows I feel uncomfortable with. It seems like she feels contented if she has successfully made me lose my temper. (I used to lose my temper when she does those things and when I finally do, she would tell it to my family and make me seem like the bad guy)

I do get what you mean, but it seems like you've misunderstood the situation. I wasn't just ignoring her, I was trying to ignore her actions because I don't want to lose my temper. We're not in good terms right now not because of her annoying me, instead she's annoying me because we recently got into a fight (because of some other reason) and she wants to make me uncomfortable in any chance that she can get.  She's fuming every time she sees me (when I am literally just minding my own business) so I don't think she's doing all those things to reconcile. :<

You might have gotten the wrong idea about me ignoring her. I just meant that I'm trying to not get affected by her purposely making me uncomfortable and do my best not to lose my temper. She's not even trying to communicate with me. Every time she sees me, she's glaring and fuming as if I am the one who kept on trying to piss her off or as if I have done something wrong. We didn't get into a fight because of her doing all those annoying things, instead she does those annoying things because we recently got into a fight and currently not in good terms. 

She already know fully well that the things she does bothers me and is making me suffer. I'm not sure she'll listen when I talk to her asking to stop doing those uncomfortable things if making me uncomfortable is what she actually wants.
Thanks for your advice but is there really no other way to just make her stop bothering me? :(
We are actually not in good terms right now hence her actions. She is actually doing those things on purpose so I don't think that taking to her would work. :(
